instruction: Change the font size to 14 points throughout the entire document.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing font size throughout the document to 14pt. The evaluator uses a custom getter to extract all font sizes from the DOCX file and a custom metric to verify all fonts are 14pt. The postconfig saves the file to ensure formatting changes persist.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly handles both explicit and inherited font sizes: checks run.font.size, run.style.font.size, paragraph.style.font.size, and document default (lines 57-75)
Getter properly extracts font sizes from all text runs in the document, providing complete coverage
Metric logic is correct: checks all extracted font sizes against target 14.0pt with 0.5pt tolerance for floating point differences
Metric parameter handling is correct: uses 'expected.get("font_size")' which properly accesses rules dict when expected.type="rule"
Expected value is correct: 14.0pt matches the instruction requirement
Postconfig correctly activates window and saves file (Ctrl+S) to persist formatting changes before verification
Data flow is correct: getter extracts all font sizes → metric compares all against 14.0 → returns 1.0 if all match, 0.0 otherwise
Minor: Fallback default of 11.0pt (line 44) is a reasonable assumption for DOCX files when actual default cannot be read from styles
